SELECT emma_budget_spent() AS spent_month,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_cycles WHERE mode = 'WAKE' AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS wakes_today,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(y ORDER BY y.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT mode, left(thoughts, 300) AS thoughts, created_at FROM emma_cycles ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3) y) AS last_cycles,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(q ORDER BY q.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, kind, summary, status, (core_os_approval_id IS NULL) AS unsent FROM n8n_action_queue WHERE created_at > now() - interval '3 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) q) AS proposals;

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(y ORDER BY y.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT mode, thoughts, actions, created_at FROM emma_cycles
     WHERE created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) y) AS cycles,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(l ORDER BY l.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT action_type, ok, left(detail, 120) AS detail, created_at FROM emma_action_log
     WHERE created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) l) AS action_log,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(q ORDER BY q.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, kind, summary, status FROM n8n_action_queue
     WHERE created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) q) AS proposals,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT kind, title, url, created_at FROM emma_artifacts
     WHERE created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) a) AS artifacts,
  emma_budget_spent() AS spent_month;
